verdicts.reason: A separates the green circle from the phone, leaving the circle stranded at the far left. SOLSTICE sits below the headline, so the reading order is inverted. The CTA is crammed into a row with the badges at the same small size and does not stand out. The tagline is orphaned in tiny type to the right of the phone, and there are dead gaps across the banner. B keeps the headline dominant and the phone inside its circle, and it gives the CTA real weight. However, the SOLSTICE wordmark is shrunk to an illegible speck at the far left. The SUMMER ONLY badge is blown up to CTA size and competes with the CTA. The tagline is jammed against the top edge, and the right cluster is cramped.
